headline: Enterprise-ready payroll: The real test is how it handles exceptions
summary: Enterprise payroll software often fails not because of large employee headcount, but due to an inability to manage complex operational exceptions and business variations. When rigid, standardized platforms cannot accommodate unique pay cycles or custom structures, organizations are forced into error-prone manual workarounds and offline spreadsheets. Consequently, true enterprise readiness depends on software configurability that aligns with an organization's actual operational structures.

headline: Hunar.AI secures Rs 40 crore to transform frontline workforce management
summary: Hunar.AI, a conversational AI startup focused on frontline workforce management, has raised Rs 40 crore in a Series A funding round led by Blume Ventures. The platform provides multilingual voice AI tools designed to streamline high-volume hiring, training, and retention for industries such as retail and logistics. The fresh capital will be used to enhance the company's technology infrastructure, expand its product suite, and enter new markets.

headline: What your first job teaches you that no classroom can
summary: While formal education provides theoretical knowledge and clear answers, a first job teaches crucial workplace skills such as navigating ambiguity, taking ownership of problems, and managing complex stakeholder dynamics. HR leaders emphasize that early career success depends heavily on initiative, attitude, and understanding informal organizational communication rather than technical expertise alone.

headline: Rising Star: Hema Lakra on why leadership starts with admitting you don’t have all the answers
summary: NatWest HR Director Hema Lakra argues that effective leadership during organizational transformations relies on transparency and acknowledging when leaders do not have every answer. She identifies manager effectiveness as a key priority for driving engagement and execution, as employees experience company strategy primarily through their direct supervisors. Additionally, Lakra highlights the importance of honesty and consistency when communicating difficult business decisions.

headline: Will Barclays’ job cuts hit India amid AI push?
summary: Barclays is eliminating approximately 5,000 global jobs, representing 5% of its workforce, as part of an AI-driven modernization plan aimed at cutting £1.1 billion in costs by 2027. The reductions heavily target support and developer roles, impacting back-office operations in India alongside UK retail banking. This move reflects a broader trend across major financial institutions utilizing automation to streamline operations, raising concerns over employee reskilling.

headline: Finmart appoints Shweta M as group HR director
summary: Finmart has appointed Shweta M as its new group human resources director, effective October 2026. Based in Dubai, she will oversee the company's overall HR strategy, including talent acquisition, Emiratisation, and employee engagement. Shweta brings over 18 years of HR experience across various sectors, most recently serving as the HR lead at Policybazaar.ae.

headline: Bengaluru employee alleges manager pressured him to resign over high salary
summary: A Bengaluru-based employee recently alleged on social media that his manager pressured him to resign because his salary exceeded the team's budget. The employee noted that no performance issues were cited and expressed concern that the demand was timed ahead of an upcoming appraisal cycle. The claims currently remain unverified, and no official company response has been provided.

headline: TVS Supply Chain Solutions appoints Subhashree Pradeep as CHRO
summary: TVS Supply Chain Solutions has appointed Subhashree Pradeep as its Chief Human Resources Officer, effective October 2026. Pradeep brings nearly 20 years of experience to the role, having previously held HR leadership positions at Larsen & Toubro, Sodexo, and Star Health & Allied Insurance, as well as an earlier seven-year tenure at TVS. In her new role, she will focus on talent development, organizational effectiveness, and aligning HR strategies with business priorities.

headline:
Myntra’s
FY26 financials: How falling logistics income dragged revenue down
summary: Myntra reported a net loss of ₹579.4 crore for FY26, driven primarily by a 53.2% drop in logistics revenue that dragged down overall operating revenue. While advertising income saw solid growth, advertising expenses remained substantially higher than ad revenues, straining overall margins. The financial performance comes as parent company Flipkart Group publishes consolidated results following its redomiciliation to India.
